name: Main product - compact
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Main product - compact.
Assign the compact product template to a product, then arrange the title, price, variants, quantity, buy buttons, and description blocks.
Native option swatches appear when option values have color or image swatch data. The full media disclosure includes every product image and rich media item.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Desktop media position
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for desktop media position. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Gap
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust gap. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Custom Liquid
settings.how: Advanced: add trusted Liquid or HTML only when native settings cannot meet the need. Work in a duplicated unpublished theme. Do not paste credentials, untrusted scripts, or a second product form inside purchase controls.

settings.label: Heading
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Content
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.
